$comment: Encoder settings and the renderer contract (PHASE 9). Separated from camera-model.json because framing is a creative decision and encoding is a delivery one; they change for different reasons and by different people. See DECISIONS.md ADR-032.

narration-1080p.$comment: yuv420p and the even-dimension requirement are not preferences - a 4:2:0 encode of an odd-sized frame is rejected by libx264, and yuv444 will not play in Safari or on most TVs.

review-720p.$comment: For sending someone a link. Small, fast, and never the deliverable.

engines.$comment: Render targets, in the sense ADR-021 gives the word for TTS: the plan is the contract and an engine consumes it. `ffmpeg` is the reference engine and the only implemented one. `hyperframes` is declared because PLAN section 9 names it, and is unimplemented because the tool is not present in this repository and cannot be inspected, versioned, or verified from here (ADR-032).

ffmpeg.subtitles: sidecar, or burned in through libass

hyperframes.consumes: the same video plan; camera.frames are authoritative over keyframes
hyperframes.blocked_on: the tool is not available here to inspect or pin a version of

requirements.$comment: What render_video.py --check probes for. Each is reported as present or missing with the reason it matters, so a failed render is diagnosed before it starts rather than a third of the way through.
requirements.frames: PHASE 8 rendered PNG frames for the animation being assembled
requirements.audio: the WAV the timeline was fitted to
requirements.font: a Thai-capable font file, only when burning subtitles in
requirements.shaping: Raqm/HarfBuzz in Pillow, only when burning subtitles in
